text:
If you’re heading out this afternoon, Burlington is delivering exactly what was promised: clear skies and 57 degrees already, with a little more warming left before topping out near 58. It’ll stay sunny and dry through the rest of the afternoon, then turn sharply colder after sunset. Tonight is clear with a low around 34, so have the warmer layer ready for any evening plans.

Wednesday keeps the quiet pattern going, with full sunshine, a high around 56, and a much lighter north breeze. There’s no rain in the forecast, and the forecasters’ own discussion keeps the stretch dry through the rest of the week. Enjoy the afternoon outdoors, but plan on a cold walk home tonight.
